payload.claim: No test verifies what text is actually sent to `git apply` in the critic cell. `_stub_the_runtime`'s `_exec_stream` and `_stub_critic_apply`'s override both discard the `stdin_data` kwarg and answer purely from a returncode/stderr the test hands them, so `_apply_and_commit_patch` forwarding the wrong bytes — or none — would not move a single assertion. Changing `stdin_data=patch,` to `stdin_data="",` at this line leaves all five new critic-cell witnesses green while the critic would silently review the base tree instead of the shipped patch, which is the exact failure backlog item 118 exists to close.
